name: Deduction Audit Agent
reads: Verifies retailer tax invoices against distributor opening/closing stock to detect phantom billing Connected CPG systems: SAP IBP · DMS · Retail POS.
does: Computes exact volume-based discounts and special promotional scheme credits per trade contract (Deterministic Secondary Sales Volume Slab Engine + BigQuery Phantom Invoice Anomaly Classifier + ERP Credit Note Broker).
returns: Drafts validated credit memos in Enterprise ERP (MCP / On-Prem DB) and posts instant settlement notifications to distributor portals Stages policy-checked action via Enterprise ERP (MCP / On-Prem DB) Credit Memo (FB01/VF01), Distributor Statement Reconciliation & Instant Settlement Notice.
stops_at: Never commits unapproved SAP IBP ledger mutations or overrides safety/contract policy without human sign-off.
